company.description: Golixco is a company/startup focused on solving problems and building products using the current era of artificial intelligence.
company.mission: Build intelligent products that empower creators, developers and dreamers to achieve more with technology. Simplicity, innovation and impact guide the work.
company.core_idea: Golixco explores what can be built when modern artificial intelligence, software, creativity, experimentation, and product development are combined.

philosophy.core_belief: The current era of AI makes it possible for a very small operation to build meaningful software and products using AI as a major part of the development process.
approach: Explore what is possible with small-scale AI-powered company structures

lolixco.name: Lolixco
lolixco.description: A cinematic video-edit discovery and AI-assisted edit-analysis platform for people who create and enjoy edits.

launch_catalog.qualification: Initial launch catalog only; this is not a permanent or real-time catalog count.

live_features.Home: Curated edit discovery, including Edit of the Moment.
live_features.Explore: Browse the edit collection and discover visual entertainment.
live_features.Shorts: Browse short-form edits in a mobile-friendly viewing experience.
live_features.Edit of the Moment: A featured edit surfaced for discovery; no rotation schedule is publicly confirmed.
live_features.Immersion: A focused, immersive viewing experience for watching edits.
live_features.Creator Studio: Experimental AI-assisted feedback on compatible local video uploads or eligible public YouTube URLs.
live_features.Mobile browsing: The responsive website supports video browsing on mobile devices.

dimensions.name: Beat Synchronization / Audiovisual Rhythm
dimensions.description: How well visual edits align with the music, rhythm and audiovisual timing.

dimensions.name: Cuts & Transitions
dimensions.description: The effectiveness, precision and quality of cuts and transitions.

dimensions.name: Pacing
dimensions.description: How well the edit maintains its rhythm, energy and flow.

dimensions.name: Visual Craftsmanship
dimensions.description: Visual presentation, compositing and other supported aspects of execution quality.

dimensions.name: Storytelling & Coherence
dimensions.description: How the edit communicates its ideas, structure, continuity and progression.

dimensions.name: Creative Execution & Impact
dimensions.description: The edit’s distinctiveness, creative decisions and overall impact.

creator_studio.method: Combines local media-signal analysis with Gemini-supported semantic understanding where available. Assessments are experimental and evidence-based.
limitations: Scores are not perfectly accurate or objective judgments of creative worth.
Not every analysis produces all six scores.
When semantic inference is unavailable, supported partial feedback may still be presented.
Compatibility and public URL eligibility affect which inputs can be analyzed.
Do not invent file-size limits, codecs, durations, model versions, quotas or processing guarantees.
Public-beta features and availability may change.
Mobile website support does not mean native mobile applications are available.
Do not claim ownership of third-party entertainment content. Direct rights and removal requests to rights@golixco.com.
